Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AXP.
Operating income reached $6.8 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 19% to 25% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2020.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.26 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We generated $1.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 40 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
